resources.string: A transparent guard blocks taps, drags and Back while the screen keeps updating. It remains above other apps until unlocked.\nHold the bottom-left badge for 3 seconds; movement or multiple fingers cancels unlocking. The notification can unlock immediately; turning the screen off also stops the guard.\nThe guard keeps the screen awake. Ride mode also stays awake.
Use rain touch guard when navigating

Apps cannot block every Home or Recents gesture. In Google Maps, open Recents and choose Pin; enable app pinning in system security first if needed. Availability varies by phone.\nPinning reduces accidental exits; the touch guard reduces interactions inside the map.
Hold the badge, or use this notification to unlock immediately.
Allow overlays and notifications before enabling the guard and its emergency unlock.
Permissions ready. Touch guard is off.
